fields.description: Equiterra 2 is a three- and four-bedroom townhouse neighbourhood at Grand Polo Club & Resort. Its architecture takes cues from equestrian estates, with contemporary interiors and landscaped communal spaces. This second release has a separate 384-home launch collection and its own payment programme.

overview: The brochure brings together warm neutral interiors, textured finishes and polished stone flooring. Outside the homes, a green central landscape connects the equestrian setting with places to exercise, gather and relax. Pools, yoga platforms and an amphitheatre complement the larger clubhouse, stables and riding arenas. These are proposed community facilities; opening dates and any membership requirements need separate confirmation.
research.locationNote: Equiterra 2 is part of Grand Polo Club & Resort in Dubai. The developer's location map uses Al Maktoum International Airport, The Oasis and Expo City as nearby reference destinations. Travel depends on the chosen entrance, road network and traffic; brochure journey times are not a commute guarantee.
research.priceNote: Emaar displays AED 3.5m. The phase-two fact sheet lists average launch prices of AED 3.5m for three-bedroom and AED 4.6m for four-bedroom homes. An average is not a minimum or a current quotation. Confirm the selected unit's availability, price and payment balance.
research.paymentNote: The release schedule requires 80% before completion and 20% at completion. The two 15% instalments are tied to construction progress. Historical dates remain launch references; a later purchase requires a fresh statement of amounts due.
research.handoverNote: The Equiterra 2 payment document estimates July 2029, consistent with the document host's Q3 2029 listing. This is an estimated construction-completion date, subject to the contract and current developer updates.

facts.label: Phase-two launch mix
facts.value: 384 townhouses: 246 three-bedroom and 138 four-bedroom homes. This is the launch collection, not current available stock.

facts.label: Category averages
facts.value: Three-bedroom homes: average BUA 2,175 sq ft and plot 1,583 sq ft. Four-bedroom homes: average BUA 2,467 sq ft and plot 3,087 sq ft. Individual plots and layouts vary.

facts.label: Layout and area basis
facts.value: Styles A and B sit in four-, six- and eight-home rows. The four-bedroom Style A drawing includes a ground-floor guest bedroom and maid's room, with three bedrooms upstairs. Published total areas include garage and balcony/terrace components.

facts.label: Drawing discrepancy
facts.value: The 2,171.42 sq ft Style B variant has inconsistent metric totals and a small component discrepancy across mirrored drawings. Published square-foot totals are retained; verify the signed unit area schedule.
